research_question: Can the unused $250 cash reserve in the selected Book A baseline earn a robust incremental return by holding the frozen S102 regime strategy, or is S102 useful only as a DOWN-regime ETH short hedge?
selection_disclosure: Both parent strategies and the shared history were inspected before S107 was conceived. S107 is a portfolio-construction diagnostic and can reject a candidate, but historical success can authorize paper-forward observation only.

book_a.definition: BOOK_A_ALT_RM plus BOOK_A_RISK_DEFAULT and corrected quantity/cash ledger

s102.definition: Frozen S102 six-asset long book in UP, ETH-only short in DOWN, cash in SIDEWAYS

variants.book_a_cash: Control: $250 Book A plus $250 uninvested cash.
variants.book_a_s102_full: Candidate: $250 Book A plus the complete frozen $250 S102 sleeve.
variants.book_a_s102_short_only: Candidate: $250 Book A plus a mechanical S102 target filter retaining negative weights only. Empty weekly targets are retained so shorts close when S102 exits DOWN.

predeclared_historical_gate_per_candidat.profit: Candidate net PnL must exceed Book A plus cash under base, stress and severe costs; candidate stress and severe net PnL must remain positive.
predeclared_historical_gate_per_candidat.tail_risk: Under stress, candidate continuous drawdown may be at most 1.00 percentage point worse than control and candidate daily ES95 may be at most 0.10 percentage point worse than control.
predeclared_historical_gate_per_candidat.breadth: Stress excess PnL versus control must be positive in at least 50% of calendar months.
predeclared_historical_gate_per_candidat.paired_uncertainty: Deterministic 10,000-sample 28-day block bootstrap 95% lower bound of stress excess PnL must be greater than zero.
predeclared_historical_gate_per_candidat.time_slices: No predeclared stress slice may underperform control by more than $2.00.
predeclared_historical_gate_per_candidat.short_evidence: The filtered S102 short contribution under stress must be positive and the shared window must contain at least five non-empty short decisions.
predeclared_historical_gate_per_candidat.decision: A candidate passing every check becomes a paper-forward challenger only. Otherwise it is rejected at the historical gate. If both candidates pass, select the one with higher stress net PnL; break an exact tie with lower stress drawdown.

paper_forward.promotion_requires: Positive stress PnL and positive paired excess with bootstrap lower bound above zero on untouched post-t0 observations; no worse drawdown or ES95 than the control.

claim_policy: No backtest or paper result guarantees profit. No leverage or live capital is authorized by this protocol.
